answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Invested animal welfare inspector warrant with animal welfare attestation. It requires a warrant welfare officers renew after inspection audits, so the kernel of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the pearl first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The ripple is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
